name: alluvium
description: Auto-archive Claude Code sessions to your Obsidian vault as a Karpathy-style LLM wiki.
author: Eric

hooks.description: Resolve config, write per-session metadata, decide self-filter. Reads stdin JSON payload for session context.
Snapshot transcript before compaction so original detail is not lost. Reads stdin JSON payload.
Spawn detached archive worker; hook returns within 100ms. Reads stdin JSON payload for session_id and transcript_path.
Clean up per-session cache directory. Reads stdin JSON payload.
